title: MnO2-decorated graphene oxide nanosheet composites as promising electrode materials for lithium-ion battery energy storage applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16015-16027
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02093J, Paper

Yen Kim Nguyen Chuong, Vu Van Thang, Thuy Trang Thi Vuong, Phat Tan Vu, Thi Viet Bac Phung, Long Phi Nguyen, Phung My Loan Le
MnO2 nanoflakes and graphene oxide (GO) from spent Zn–C batteries via electrochemical exfoliation, used as anode material for lithium-ion batteries, show good specific capacity, supporting sustainable energy storage and recycling.
